chunks: Thus, when he left them and the (idols) they worshipped, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet,
ai.seo_question: Who did Allah bestow upon Abraham after he left his people's idols?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine selection of the Ahl al-Bayt lineage, where the gift of Isaac and Jacob signifies the continuation of prophetic authority following Abraham's purification from idolatry. The phrase 'and We made them all prophets' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi to emphasize the unique spiritual status and infallibility of these patriarchs, linking them to the broader chain of Imams.
